title: Add Orange City (Pollinations AI Edition) to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Orange City (Pollinations AI Edition)](https://github.com/GermanIllan/orange_city) to image
- A Python plugin for GIMP 3.2 that generates stylized oil-painted cityscapes with AI-generated background skies powered by Pollinations.ai. **Direct link to Pollinations API integration in source code:

Fixes #13198

gist.headline: Oil paint meets open skies
gist.blurb: Orange City has landed in the greenhouse: a GIMP 3.2 plugin that paints cityscapes, then lets Pollinations supply the sky. The clouds have finally joined the art department.
gist.summary: Added Orange City (Pollinations AI Edition) to the app catalog: a Python plugin for GIMP 3.2 that creates stylized oil-painted cityscapes with AI-generated background skies from the Pollinations API.
gist.impact: Artists and tinkerers can now discover a GIMP workflow that combines hand-styled urban scenes with Pollinations-generated skies directly from the app catalog.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy pixel-art painter's studio where Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, helps a GIMP-like retro monitor paint an oil-textured orange cityscape. A Pollinations-powered sky generator should appear as a glowing garden-cloud machine producing pastel clouds above the canvas, with flowers and code-plants around the workspace.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow bee mascot with dark brown stripes, pink rectangular cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny painter's beret, hovering beside a chunky retro art computer as it paints an orange oil-painted cityscape; a small glowing sky generator grows soft pastel clouds from code-plants and lime green (#ecf874) flower pots. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes like Stardew Valley, with subtle pixel-font text reading “ORANGE CITY”; nostalgic, emotionally warm, and clearly not realistic.
